long_biography.plain_text:
Motor dealer Neil Macfarquhar paid close attention to how used-car stock matched customer demand. At Hoffman Ford, he chose not to pursue used imports and questioned the value of some ex-rental cars offered to dealers. His assessment reflected the practical competition between franchise yards, rental fleets and consignment retailers.

His interest in cars also extended to competition. After about a decade of New Zealand rallying, Targa events and hill climbs, he moved into Group A racing. He entered the Leadfoot Festival in 2013 with a Ford Sierra prepared by the Eggenberger works team. He had also developed a modified Ford Laser for Targa, a car subsequently rebuilt and raced by another enthusiast.
